design_brief_zh: 主卖点为可核验的使用支持与售后事实：三位TSA密码锁便于海关查验，包装含行李箱、说明书和保修卡，并提供三年保修。不得将其表述为保证快速过检、绝对安全、牢靠耐用或官方认证。PC画布2000×2000采用标题→支持说明→证据/细节1→证据/细节2的阅读顺序，顶部居中放置标题，标题下方居中放支持说明；左下依次放包装清单与三年保修，右侧为银色、枪灰色或黑色13A行李箱三分之四视角，并在锁具附近加入局部放大。说明书和保修卡平放在锁具旁，作为包装事实的视觉证明，文件版式保持中性，不虚构文字或认证标志。移动端1200×1200保持顶部标题与支持说明、上方产品锁具场景、底部左右分列包装清单和保修三年的顺序。产品展示竖条纹硬壳、金属色框架、防撞角、双锁和拉杆，避免把未展示或未核验的内饰、轮数和性能加入画面。使用低饱和中性色纸面、自然侧光与锁具柔和重点光；字体采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，突出“三位”和“三年”，德语文案预留约20%横向扩展空间。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的三位TSA密码锁、便于查验、说明书、保修卡、行李箱包装清单和三年保修事实。不得声称保证快速过检、绝对安全、牢靠耐用、保证通关、官方认证、性能测试或额外售后服务。不得将说明书、保修卡或杯子等未确认内容绘制成额外配件；文件与行李箱外观应与实物一致。
image_prompt_en: Create a square Amazon A+ visual module for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase. Follow this exact composition: top-centered headline area, centered supporting line beneath it, product scene on the right with a three-quarter view suitcase and a close-up inset of the external three-digit TSA combination lock, and two numbered evidence blocks on the lower left for package contents and three-year warranty. Show a realistic silver, gunmetal gray, or black vertically ridged hard-shell suitcase with visible metal-colored frame, corner protectors, hinges, dual lock area, and telescopic handle. Place a realistic neutral instruction booklet and warranty card beside the lock as packaging evidence, without inventing document layouts, logos, certification marks, or extra accessories. PC composition should read top to bottom, then left evidence to right product; mobile version should place the suitcase and lock scene in the upper section and two evidence blocks side by side at the bottom. Use European modern travel photography, low-saturation neutral palette, natural side lighting, soft emphasis on the lock and documents, clean background, premium trustworthy mood, and generous negative space. Use typography-safe blank regions for later text placement. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or labels in the image.
